playground.title: Playground
playground.intro: Runnable, editable versions of the core wimui recipes. Each card renders live below, and "Open in StackBlitz" boots a full Vite + React 19 project — wired with the required styles.css and WimProvider — against the published wimui package, so you can try before you adopt. Expand "View source" to see the exact code that ships to the sandbox.
playground.note: The sandboxes install wimui from npm and open in a new tab. The previews here render the same source you send to StackBlitz — they can't drift, because both come from one file.
